The Registered Nurse (RN) Nurse Manager (NM) is the first-line supervisory authority accountable for the 24/7 operation of assigned units. They direct staff orientation, training, development, and evaluation while acting as a role model and supervisor.

The NM collaborates with interdisciplinary teams to enhance outcomes, ensures compliance with regulatory standards, and aligns clinical objectives with organizational strategic goals. Major duties include but are not limited to: Function as the designated first-line supervisory authority responsible for 24/7 unit operations.

Direct and supervise specific orientation, training, staff development, and individual performance evaluations. Functions as a clinical expert and is responsible and accountable for all elements of the nursing process when providing or supervising direct patient care.

Serve as a role model, educator, practitioner, and supervisor providing team leadership. Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams to remove barriers and implement evidence-based programs. Equip staff with tools for culturally competent care and promote accountability for high-quality outcomes.

Participate in the development of care delivery models and environmental design to ensure equitable care. Ensure compliance with all accreditation standards, regulatory requirements, and standard operating procedures. Align nursing and clinical objectives with organizational strategic outcomes and planning.

Promote an inclusive workplace that values diversity to achieve the organization's vision. Maintain knowledge of and ensure adherence to ethical principles in decision-making.

Learn more Permanent Change of Station (PCS): Not Authorized The VA Midwest Health Care Network advocates for a Whole Health System of care in each of the Medical Centers. This is an approach to healthcare that empowers and equips people to take charge of their health and well-being and live their lives to the fullest.

As an employee operating in a Whole Health System of care, you will operate in a model with three core elements, seeking to create a personalized health plan for each Veteran. This is done in the context of healing relationships and healing environments and a connection back to the Veteran's community.

This aligns with the Veterans Health Administration (VHA) Mission Statement to Honor America's Veterans by providing exceptional health care that improves their health and well-being.
Basic Requirements: English Language Proficiency. In accordance with 38 U.S.C. 7403(f), no person shall serve in direct patient care positions unless they are proficient in basic written and spoken English.

Graduate of a school of professional nursing approved by the appropriate accrediting agency and accredited by one of the following accrediting bodies at the time the program was completed by the applicant: The Accreditation Commission for Education in Nursing (ACEN) or The Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education (CCNE); OR Individuals attending a master's level bridge program in nursing who have completed coursework equivalent to a bachelor's level degree in Nursing may have opportunity to become registered as a nurse with a state licensing board prior to completion of the bridge program.

Upon achievement of a State license, the individual may be appointed on temporary basis and later converted to a permanent appointment upon successful completion and graduation from the bridge program.

(Reference VA Handbook 5005, Appendix G6); OR In cases of graduates of foreign schools of professional nursing, possession of a current, full, active, and unrestricted registration will meet the requirement for graduation from an approved school of professional nursing to warrant an appointment as a Nurse who has completed an associated degree/entry level Nursing education program.

Credit for foreign nursing education higher that associate degree/entry level requires a formal degree equivalency validation from a recognized equivalency evaluation accepted by VA such as International Consultants of Delaware (ICD).

Current, full, active, and unrestricted registration as a graduate professional nurse in a State, Territory or Commonwealth (i.e., Puerto Rico) of the United States, or the District of Columbia.

Graduate Nurse Technician (GNT) Exception: Candidates who otherwise meet the basic education requirements, but do not possess the required licensure, may be appointed at the entry step of the grade and level applicable to the completed nursing education as a GNT on a 120-day temporary appointment while actively pursuing licensure (may be extended up to two years on a case-by-case-basis.) NOTE: Grandfathering Provision - All persons currently employed in VHA in 0610 series and performing the duties as described in the qualification standard on the effective date of the standard (1/29/2024) are considered to have met all qualification requirements for the grade held including positive education and licensure/certification.

Grade Determinations: The following Scope, Education and Dimension criteria must be met in determining the grade assignment of candidates, and if appropriate, the level within a grade.

The Dimension requirements (Practice, Veteran/Patient Driven Care, Leadership, Professional Development and Evidence-Based Practice/Research) are detailed for each grade and level within the online assessment: https://apply.usastaffing.gov/ViewQuestionnaire/13040710.

Grade/Level Scope Education Nurse I, Level I Delivers fundamental, knowledge-based care to assigned clients while developing technical competencies. An Associate Degree (ADN) or Diploma in Nursing, with no additional professional nursing required.

Nurse I, Level II Demonstrates integration of biopsychosocial concepts, cognitive skills and technically competent practice in providing care to clients with basic or complex.

An ADN or Diploma in Nursing AND 1 year of specialized nursing experience equivalent to Nurse I, Level 1 ;OR a Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) with no additional professional nursing experience required. Nurse I, Level III Demonstrates proficiency in practice based on conscious and deliberate planning.

Self-directed in goal setting for managing complex client situations.

An ADN or Diploma in Nursing AND 2 years of professional nursing experience in which one year is equivalent to Nurse I, Level 2; OR a BSN and 1 year of professional nursing experience equivalent to the Nurse I, Level 2; OR a Master's degree in nursing (MSN) and no additional professional nursing experience; OR a Master's degree in a *related field with a BSN and no additional professional nursing experience.

Nurse II Demonstrates leadership in delivering and improving holistic care through collaborative strategies with others.

A BSN with 2 years of professional nursing equivalent to Nurse I, Level 3; OR an MSN with one year of specialized nursing experience equivalent to Nurse I, Level 3; OR a Master's degree in a *related field with a BSN and one year of specialized nursing experience equivalent to Nurse I, Level 3; OR a Doctoral degree in Nursing with no professional nursing experience; OR a Doctoral degree in a *related field with a BSN with no additional professional nursing experience.

Nurse III Executes position responsibilities that demonstrate leadership, experience and creative approaches to management of complex client care beyond the immediate practice setting.

MSN and 2 years of specialized nursing experience, one of which is equivalent to Nurse II and meets all dimension requirements for Nurse III; OR a Master's degree in *related field with BSN and two years of specialized nursing experience, one of which is equivalent to Nurse II and meets all dimension requirements for Nurse III; OR a Doctoral degree in Nursing with and one year of specialized nursing experience equivalent to Nurse II and meets all dimension requirements for Nurse III; OR a Doctoral degree in a *related field with a BSN and one year of specialized nursing experience equivalent to Nurse II and meets all dimension requirements for Nurse III. *Note: Foreign education programs/degrees are not creditable as related degrees.

Questions about physical demands or environmental factors may be addressed at the time of examination.

Assigned duties include, but are not limited to: Provides executive leadership and direct supervision for the Chief Nurse of Daily Nursing Operations and Professional Practice, Chief Nursing Informatics Officer (CNIO), Nurse Recruiter, Professional Governance and Pathway to Excellence Coordinator, Staffing Methodology Coordinator, Special Projects Officer and program assistant for the Nurse Qualification Standards Station Advisory Committee (NQS SAC).

Under direction of the ADPCS is an active participant in the operations of Sterile Processing Service (SPS) including programmatic oversight and management.

Responsible to evaluate technology and other systems that may impact the practice of nursing using a systems approach, they understand the implications of policies and practices on the nursing workforce and the Veterans served.

Collaborates with other executives to lead strategic planning and goal development for nursing, complex decision-making, and problem solving related to health care services and organizational priorities.

Improves the quality and effectiveness of the facility's overall health care delivery by providing leadership, coordinating, facilitating the evaluation and leading improvement projects related to nursing practice. Develops and deploys oversight systems to monitor, identify and analyze key performance indicators and variances.

Provides analysis and reporting of data, developing action plans and interventions, and assesses successes of actions in follow up. Develops, implements and evaluates Models of Nursing Care. Collaboratively works with accreditation toward the goal of continuous preparedness.

When opportunities for improvement are identified develops, implements and sustains corrective actions. Implements and sustains change plans that are assigned nursing related actions through Root Cause Analysis (RCAs) outcomes.

Acts as a change agent by skillfully facilitating multiple teams, creating, implementing, and measuring large complex projects within the integrated health system. Oversight of nursing recruitment and retention strategies and outcomes. Oversight of the MVAHCS Professional Governance program.

The following Scope, Education and Dimension criteria must be met to qualify for Nurse V: Scope: Practice of an executive nature, comprised of complex leadership and administrative components, associated with critical health care issues and activities that drive meeting the organizational mission, health care and policy.

Education: Master's degree in Nursing (MSN) and 5 years of professional nursing experience, one of which is specialized nursing experience equivalent to Nurse IV and meets all dimension requirements for Nurse V; OR Master's degree in a *related field with a BSN and 5 years of professional nursing experience, one of which is specialized nursing experience equivalent to Nurse IV and meets all dimension requirements for Nurse V; OR a Doctoral degree in Nursing and 4 years of professional nursing experience, one of which is specialized nursing experience equivalent to Nurse IV and meets all dimension requirements for Nurse V; OR a Doctoral degree in a *related field with a BSN and 4 years of professional nursing experience, one of which is specialized nursing experience equivalent to Nurse IV and meets all dimension requirements for Nurse V. *Note: Foreign education programs/degrees are not creditable as related degrees.

Dimension Requirements: Leadership. Establishes the strategic direction for health care delivery, evidence-based practices, industry-leading research, and innovative care models. Creates a shared vision and successfully leads change to improve performance and attain measurable outcomes at the organization or enterprise level. Business Acumen.

Transforms health care through the application of new processes, technology, informatics, data analytics, business principles, systems thinking and resource management at the organization or enterprise level. Inspiring an Industry-Leading Lifestyle.

Establishes an industry leading, shared decision-making lifestyle; a workforce that serves Veterans, families, and caregivers of all backgrounds; builds trust and lifestyle competencies and catalyzes dynamic teams at the organization and enterprise level. Communication and Relationship Management.

Drives the effective use of relationship management principles to achieve positive customer service experiences that are consistent with professional and organizational values, beliefs, and practices at the organizational or enterprise level. Professional and Social Responsibility.

Sets the standard for a lifestyle of holistic care, health advocacy and health equity. Applies ethical principles in decision-making at the organization or enterprise level.

Advances nursing knowledge through health science research and the translation and dissemination of evidence into practice to maximize the value to Veterans, the community, and the health care industry. Duties include, but are not limited to: Responsible for providing competent, evidence-based care to assigned residents and oversight of licensed vocational nurses/nursing assistants, as appropriate to the setting.

Assists in directing the provision of nursing education, orientation, competencies and providing quality improvement and outcomes utilization consultation. Demonstrates leadership in delivering and improving holistic care through collaborative strategies with others. Provides peers with informal constructive feedback for improvement.

Fosters a safe and supportive environment conducive to the professional development of healthcare professionals. Contributes professional nursing perspective in discussions with the interdisciplinary team. Shares educational findings, experiences, and ideas with peers.

Collaborates with the Minimum Data Set (MDS) coordinator to ensure documentation is accurate and reflective of the Resource Utilization Group (RUG) score.

Physical Requirements: This clinical position includes a level of physicality normally associated with inpatient care, including bending, grasping, kneeling, performing moderation lifting, carrying tasks of up to 35 pounds per the Safe Patient Handling and Mobility (SPHM) guidelines and using an appropriate mechanical lift.

Candidate must possess the ability to pivot their waist and neck, push and pull items not greater than 35 pounds and reach within a five-foot distance or above shoulder height. The position requires sitting, squatting, standing, walking and twisting, alongside wrist flexion and extension.

Employees are expected to employ proper body mechanics during lifting. Requires adequate vision to accurately perform the assigned duties, distinguish basic colors and assess patients and the environment safely. The position requires the ability to hear at a level to perform the assigned duties, and the use of hearing aids permitted.

Duties and responsibilities of the COMMUNITY CARE NETWORK (CCN) CARE MANAGER REGISTERED NURSE include, but are not limited to: Community Care Network (CCN) Care Manager, is a registered nurse (RN), who executes position responsibilities that demonstrate leadership, experience, and creative approaches to management of complex client care within VHA and VA-Community Care program.

RN has the primary responsibility for providing clinical expertise in coordinating Veteran care under the care for Short Term Rehab (30, 60, 90 and up to 100 calendar days) in a Skilled Nursing Facility, in the community for planned and unplanned/emergent episodes of care, and discharge disposition needs.

This includes receipt of initial requests for transfers from community hospitals to skilled nursing facilities under OPTUM. The RN provides close monitoring of continued stay reviews, maintaining nursing standards across service lines, as well as being able to multitask, be flexible and adaptable in the evolving community care environment.

The CCN will collaborate with the Veteran, family, the primary care provider (PCP), the specialty care provider (SCP), the payor, and all other service professionals and paraprofessionals. The CCN will maintain direct, open, and honest communication while adhering to the Veteran's rights of privacy and confidentiality.

The RN will evaluate patient safety and satisfaction, participate in performance improvement projects and monitor data to determine effectiveness of care. The CCN spends substantial time communicating and educating. Therefore, it is vital to possess the skills to communicate clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing.

Responsible for participating within unit based and/or organizational level Shared Governance councils, utilizing clinical expertise, evidence-based practice, and knowledge to assist with finding solutions to problems or issues to improve the quality care provided to our veterans.

Physical Requirements: This position includes a level of physicality normally associated with direct patient care duties performed by nurses as potentially long periods of continued walking, standing, sitting, stooping, moderate lifting, or kneeling.

Examples may include but are not limited to: Reaching, crouching, stooping, stretching Assisting patients and moving equipment, repeated bending, pushing, and/or pulling. Significant amounts of time standing while assisting assigned patients. Utilization of safe patient handing and mobility protocols.

Visual acuity and keen hearing Manual dexterity Possible exposure to infected patients and contaminated materials and may be required to do personal protective clothing in isolation situations. Operative/invasive procedures Exposure to patients who are combative secondary to delirium, dementia, or mental health disorders.

Employee must complete employee health requirements as directed.

The Cardiac Catheterization / Electrophysiology Laboratory / Interventional Radiology (CCL-EP- IR) Nurse II, assumes the following roles and responsibilities: Effectively functions as the team leader, or in other leadership role that guides and directs others who provide patient care.

Performs case management duties to include scheduling, lab review, medication review, and collaboration. Triages phone calls, incoming pre/post-procedural patients, and unit flow. Organizes and coordinates staff and resources to identify and address unit problems, issues, and needs to improve existing processes.

Initiates collaborating with other disciplines/departments to achieve desired patient outcomes. Coordinates unit flow to maintain efficiency. Participates in shared governance, team meetings, and process improvement activities, monitors results, and advocates for self and staff compliance to regulatory requirements.

Responds to changing priorities and resources with optimism, encouraging staff to respond positively and proactively. Supports department strategic planning and assist with unit-based educational programs and activities. Conserves resources effectively by using supplies and equipment in a responsible manner.

Able to locate resources of supplies and/or equipment if needed. Educates or initiates unit-based in-services and mandatory educational activities in a self- directed manner. The Admission/Discharge Coordinator Registered Nurse (RN) executes position responsibilities that demonstrate leadership, experience, and creative approaches to management of complex patient care. The nurse is an active member of an interdisciplinary team whose primary focus is on care transitions to and from an inpatient setting.

Assists with patient planning assessments, identification of barriers, and activities required to successfully transition the patient in and out of the acute inpatient setting. Applies the nursing process which includes systematic data gathering, assessment, and appropriate nursing judgment to ensure positive patient outcomes.

Coordinates and collaborates with other VA and non-VA departments, community agencies, and healthcare providers to ensure patient needs are addressed. Collaborates in the development, implementation, evaluation, and revision of policies, procedures, and/or guidelines.

Demonstrates performance and leadership that is broad enough to improve the care for a group of patients. Provides peers with formal or informal constructive feedback for improvement. Supports colleagues and other nurses through knowledge sharing to provide safe, quality nursing care.

Program or service level outcomes must be broad and complex and can be demonstrated at any organizational level within a facility.The Community Living Center (CLC) Resident Assessment Coordinator (RAC) Registered Nurse (RN) executes position responsibilities that demonstrate leadership, experience, and creative approaches to management of complex resident care.

Collaborates in the development, implementation, evaluation, and revision of policies, procedures, and/or guidelines. Demonstrates performance and leadership that is broad enough to improve the care for CLC residents.

Leading the CLC Resident Assessment Instrument (RAI)/Minimum Data Set (MDS) program, which includes serving as the Facility Administrator of the RAI/MDS program and MDS software and promoting the application of the RAI/MDS Assessment for resident care planning.

Directing the RAI/MDS RN who is responsible for coding for nursing assigned sections and Care Area Assessments (CAAs). Identifying CLC Interdisciplinary Team members to conduct the interrater reliability reviews, which must be conducted, at a minimum, quarterly.

Collaborating with CLC management or charge nurse to support the CLC Interdisciplinary Team members conducting the interrater reliability review, at a minimum, quarterly, which assesses the accuracy of the RAI/MDS Assessment and reporting trends of errors identified.

Completing the interrater reliability quarterly report and submitting it to the CLC leadership team. In the absence of a CLC MDS RN, the CLC RAC must document and take corrective action when notified of any discrepancies in coding or documentation during the interrater reliability review.

Die Station Mistral ist ein geschützter Ort mit einer klaren Tagesstruktur für Kinder zwischen 6 und 12 Jahren, die aufgrund psychischer Belastungen oder akuter Krisen intensive kinderpsychiatrische Unterstützung ötigen. Gemeinsam mit den Kindern und ihren Familien schaffen wir einen Rahmen, in dem Sicherheit, Vertrauen und neue Perspektiven entstehen können.
Wir stehen Kindern und Jugendlichen in akuten Krisensituationen zur Seite, geben Halt und Orientierung und setzen auf reflektiertes, ruhiges Handeln, um gemeinsam tragfähige Lösungen zu entwickeln.
Unser pädagogisch\-therapeutisches Milieu verbindet psychodynamische, verhaltenstherapeutische und systemische Ansätze. Wir arbeiten eng mit der Klinikschule, den Familien und einem multiprofessionellen Team zusammen, um Entwicklung Schritt für Schritt zu ermöglichen.
Deine Aufgaben
Du begleitest Kinder im pädagogisch\-therapeutischen Milieu und unterstützt sie dabei, ihre Gefühle besser wahrzunehmen, neue Bewältigungsstrategien zu entwickeln und ihren Therapieprozess aktiv mitzugestalten
Du begleitest Kinder in akuten Krisensituationen, stellst Sicherheit her, gibst Orientierung und unterstützt das Team, die Krise fachlich zu klären
Du trägst Mitverantwortung bei der Gestaltung und Leitung von Gruppentherapien
Du arbeitest als Bezugsperson eng mit Fachpersonen aus Pädagogik, Psychologie, Medizin und Therapie zusammen
Du bringst deine fachliche Perspektive in den diagnostischen Prozess ein und hilfst mit, ein gemeinsames Fallverständnis zu entwickeln
Du arbeitest im Schichtbetrieb ohne Nachtdienste
Du übernimmst Verantwortung für dokumentierte Zielklärungen und die Umsetzung der therapeutischen Schritte im Alltag
Du gestaltest die Zusammenarbeit mit Eltern und Sorgeberechtigten konstruktiv und wertschätzend
Du unterstützt neue Fachpersonen in der Praxisausbildung und begleitest sie im Alltag
Du trägst zur Weiterentwicklung unserer pädagogischen Qualität und zur Einhaltung der Leistungsziele der Klinik bei
Dein Profil
Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung in Sozialpädagogik HF / FH oder als Pflegefachperson HF/FH und bringst idealerweise Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Kindern und Jugendlichen mit
Du bringst die nötige Qualifikation für die Praxisausbildung mit oder bist bereit, einen Fachkurs zu absolvieren
Du hast Freude an Beziehungsgestaltung, Alltagsstruktur und der Arbeit mit Familien
Du hast die Fähigkeit, dein Handeln zu reflektieren und in Krisensituationen ruhig und lösungsorientiert zu bleiben
Du bist flexibel, belastbar und hast Freude an der interdisziplinären Zusammenarbeit
Du kannst einen einwandfreien Leumund ausweisen (Privat\- und Sonderprivatauszug)
Du bringst sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift mit, jede weitere Sprache ist ein Plus

Du möchtest die Ausbildung zur Pflegefachperson HF starten und suchst einen Ausbildungsbetrieb? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!
Auch für Quereinsteiger\*innen ist dieses Studium bestens geeignet. Wir begleiten und unterstützen dich dabei.
Aufgaben
Du lernst alles rund um Pflege und Betreuung in der Langzeitpflege in einem Umfeld, das sich Ausbildung und Nachwuchsförderung auf die Fahne geschrieben hat und die nötigen Ressourcen vollumfänglich zur Verfügung stellt.
Du lernst und erlebst bei uns, wie spannend, abwechslungsreich und attraktiv die Zusammenarbeit von diplomierten Pflegefachpersonen, der Ärzteschaft und weiteren Medizinalpersonen wie Physio\- und Ergotherapeut\*innen ist.
Du hast die Möglichkeit, an Einblickstagen in internen Bereichen wie Fallbesprechungen und medizinischen Therapien teilzunehmen und auf verschiedenen Abteilungen die unterschiedlichen Schwerpunkte in der Langzeitpflege vertieft kennenzulernen.
Du wirst während deines Studiums von gut qualifizierten Berufsbildner\*innen begleitet und profitierst vom Austausch mit anderen Studierenden und Auszubildenden auf deiner Abteilung.

Teamfähigkeit und Freude am Umgang mit Menschen
Geschick bei praktischen Arbeiten, Sorgfalt und Hygienebewusstsein

Fähigkeit zur professionellen Kommunikation und Beziehungsgestaltung
Wir bieten
Als Studierende\*r der höheren Fachschule Pflege (HF) wirst du bei uns Teil des Teams und lernst die Pflege in all ihren Facetten kennen – von Langzeitpflege, über Demenz, Geriatrie, Gerontopsychiatrie bis hin zu Palliative Care und rehabilitativer Übergangspflege.
Das Vollzeitstudium dauert drei Jahre, kann jedoch als ausgebildete Fachperson Gesundheit EFZ verkürzt, innert zwei Jahren absolviert werden. Zusätzlich bieten wir auch ein Teilzeitstudium an, welches in einem 60% Pensum innerhalb von vier Jahren absolviert werden kann.
Wir bieten dir eine professionelle Ausbildungsumgebung mit engagierten Berufsbildner\*innen, einer offenen Du\-Kultur, Teamgeist und Leidenschaft. Bei der Stadt Zürich profitierst du von attraktiven Arbeitsbedingungen und umfassenden Sozialleistungen. Unsere Häuser schaffen ein besonderes Flair und die ideale Umgebung, um deine Talente zu entfalten.

## Description de l'entreprise ##
Avec plus de 13'000 collaborateurs et collaboratrices représentant 160 métiers, les Hôpitaux Universitaires de Genève sont un établissement de référence au niveau national et international. Pour en savoir plus sur notre institution, prenez quelques minutes pour consulter notre rétrospective 2025 en cliquant ici.
Le service de gastro-entérologie et d'hépatologie prend en charge sur son plateau technique des patients et patientes ambulatoires et hospitalisés pour des examens d-endoscopie diagnostique et interventionnelle en gastro-entérologie et pneumologie.
## Description du poste ##
Au sein de l-unité d-endoscopie digestive et bronchique, vous assurez la prise en charge de patients et patientes ambulatoires et hospitalisés bénéficiant d-examens diagnostiques et thérapeutiques dans un environnement technique spécialisé.
Vous accueillez, informez et accompagnez les patients et patientes tout au long de leur parcours de soins, de la préparation de l-examen jusqu-à la surveillance post-interventionnelle. Vous assurez la prise en charge infirmière des patients et patientes dans les phases pré-, per- et post-examen, en garantissant leur sécurité, leur confort et la qualité des soins.
Vous préparez les salles d-examen et veillez à la disponibilité ainsi qu-au bon fonctionnement du matériel et des équipements spécifiques à l-endoscopie digestive et bronchique. Vous assistez les médecins lors des différents actes diagnostiques et thérapeutiques, notamment les endoscopies digestives, bronchiques et les ponctions-biopsies, en assurant l-instrumentation et le soutien technique nécessaires.
Vous réalisez, surveillez et évaluez les sédations ainsi que la prise en charge de la douleur, en collaboration avec l-équipe médicale et conformément aux protocoles institutionnels. Vous participez au retraitement, à la désinfection et à la traçabilité des endoscopes dans le respect des normes d-hygiène et de qualité en vigueur.
Vous coordonnez le flux des patients et patientes sur le plateau technique et en salle de surveillance en faisant preuve d-autonomie, d-organisation, de réactivité et d-un excellent sens des priorités. Vous assurez une surveillance clinique rigoureuse et garantissez des transmissions pertinentes afin de favoriser la continuité et la sécurité des soins. Vous participez aux gardes ou piquets permettant d-assurer la prise en charge des urgences endoscopiques 24 heures sur 24.
Cette fonction vous offre l-opportunité d-évoluer au sein d-un plateau technique spécialisé, dynamique et innovant, au contact d-équipes pluridisciplinaires expertes en gastroentérologie et en pneumologie.

Vous bénéficiez d'un Bachelor HES en soins infirmiers ou d'un titre reconnu équivalent par la Croix-Rouge Suisse.
Vous justifiez d'une expérience de deux ans minimum en soins aigus. Une expérience en endoscopie constitue un réel atout.
Vous avez un intérêt marqué pour l-instrumentation et appréciez évoluer dans un environnement technique spécialisé. La réalisation de certains examens sous scopie nécessite le port d-un tablier de plomb durant plusieurs heures.
Vous faites preuve d'excellentes capacités d-adaptation, de gestion du stress, de tact et d-anticipation. Vous appréciez le travail en étroite collaboration avec l-équipe médicale ainsi que le travail en équipe pluridisciplinaire.
Vous êtes disposé ou disposée à suivre une période d-intégration progressive comprenant une formation spécifique jusqu-à l-acquisition de l-autonomie dans l-ensemble des examens réalisés au sein de l-unité, afin de pouvoir assurer les horaires de piquet.
Vous avez une excellente maîtrise de la langue française tant à l-orale qu-à l-écrit.
## Informations complémentaires ##
Vous assurez des horaires de jour, de nuit et de week-end selon les besoins du service.

Erholung ist wichtig. Wo auch immer Sie neue Kraft tanken wollen: bis 50 Jahre = 30 Tage, ab 50 Jahre = 33 Tage, ab 60 Jahre = 37 Tage
### Inkonvenienzen / Zulagen ###
Unsere Patient\*innen brauchen Sie auch ausserhalb regulärer Bürozeiten? Dann haben Sie ein Anrecht auf eine faire Entschädigung. Für eine Nachtschicht erhalten Sie beispielsweise eine Zulage von mindestens 10 Franken pro Stunde, an Wochenenden und Feiertagen sogar bis zu 16.50 Franken.
### Umkleidezeit ###
So banal es klingt: Berufskleidung ist keine Freizeitkleidung. Nur fair also, wenn dies auch im Berufsalltag anerkannt wird. Bei uns gilt: Umkleidezeit ist Arbeitszeit. Pro Dienst stehen Ihnen 10 Minuten fürs Umkleiden zu.
### Kinderzulagen ###
Das UKBB ist familienfreundlich. Neben den gesetzlichen Familienzulagen zahlen wir zusätzliche Unterhaltszulagen für Kinder- und Jugendliche aus. Zum Beispiel stehen Ihnen auf ein 100%-Pensum gerechnet 400 Franken pro Monat für Ihr erstes Kind zu, für zwei Kinder insgesamt 500 Franken.

Kommen Sie mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln zur Arbeit, profitieren Sie entweder von einem Rabatt von CHF 282.00 pro Jahr auf Ihr U-Abo (via Jobticket), auf Ihr GA oder auf jedes andere ÖV-Abo aus Deutschland und Frankreich.
### Gut abgesichert ###
Während Ihrer Anstellung erhalten Sie stets den vollen Lohn, auch wenn Sie ausfallen. Darüber hinaus garantieren wir Ihnen bei Krankheit eine Lohnfortzahlung von 730 Tagen. Sollten Sie je eine stationäre Behandlung infolge Unfall benötigen, sind Sie erst noch Halbprivat versichert.
### Verpflegung ###
In den Restaurants am UKBB und Universitätsspital Basel kommen Sie in den Genuss eines Personalrabatts. Ein klassisches Mittagsmenü erhalten Mitarbeitende für CHF 9.70.
### Mutterschaftsurlaub ###
Wir verlängern Ihren Mutterschaftsurlaub von 14 auf 16 Wochen zu vollem Lohn.
### Einspringen lohnt sich ###
Als Dankeschön verdienen Sie CHF 75.00 pro Einsatz, wenn Sie innerhalb von fünf Kalendertagen vor einem geplanten Frei- oder Ruhetag kurzfristig zu einem Dienst aufgeboten werden. Zusätzlich wird ein Zeitzuschlag von 25% gewährt.

The Mental Health (MH) Inpatient Psychiatric Unit Registered Nurse (RN) assumes responsibility for the coordination of care focused on patient education, self-management, and customer satisfaction throughout the continuum of care.

Duties of the position include, but are not limited to: Responsible and accountable for all elements of the nursing process when providing and/or supervising direct patient care. Administer medications and procedures per established policies and guidelines. Influence care outcomes by collaborating with members of the interdisciplinary team.

Knowledge and active participation in the unit/program level quality improvement process and initiatives as well as customer service programs.

Provide and lead the provision of competent, evidence-based care Provide patient-centered and recovery-oriented care, milieu management, and maintain self-awareness while caring for patients living with MH conditions. Facilitate shift reports, warm hand-offs, and nurse-led psychoeducational groups.

Use therapeutic communication techniques, practice de-escalation techniques, and utilize recovery-oriented language.

Participate in MH interdisciplinary treatment team, MH Environment of Care rounds, assume team lead for psychiatric emergencies, report and assist in resolving safety concerns, and document nursing assessments, nursing plan of care, and patient safety observations.

Maintain professional boundaries to protect patient vulnerabilities and act in the best interest of the patient. Oversight of licensed vocational nurses/nursing assistants, as appropriate to the setting.

Assist in directing the provision of nursing education, orientation, competencies and providing quality improvement and outcomes utilization consultation. Provide peers with informal constructive feedback for improvement. Foster a safe and supportive environment conducive to the professional development of healthcare professionals.

Contribute professional nursing perspective in discussions with the MH interdisciplinary team. Support colleagues through MH knowledge sharing to provide safe, quality nursing care. Share MH educational findings, experiences, and ideas with peers. Participate in activities and strategies to sustain evidence-based MH practice.

Other duties as assigned.

The schedule is dependent on facility needs and could rotate or shift to ensure coverage.

Holidays: Basic pay rate plus additional holiday pay equal to basic pay for each hour worked (double time) on a legal holiday/scheduled holiday or paid day off (depending on schedule). RN - Clinical Field Reviewer (Remote in Montana)
The RN Clinical Field Reviewer is a remote position that requires in-home nursing assessments which require the successful candidate to reside in one of the following Montana counties: Gallatin, Park, Sweetgrass, Stillwater, Carbon, or Yellowstone.
We are a team of Registered Nurses working remotely across the state of Montana completing in-home nursing assessments of eligible members living in the areas where we live for the Medicaid CFCS/PCS (Community First Choice Services/Personal Care Services) program.

We conduct person-centered in-home nursing assessments focused on a member’s functional abilities and their needs for ADL and IADL assistance initially, annually, and as needed if a change in condition occurs for members of all ages.

We have a shared goal of keeping members independent in their homes with the assistance of paid caregivers and informal support. We work closely with provider agencies across the state to ensure that services are being delivered to members as authorized following policies set forth by the State of Montana DPHHS.

We empower members to become participants in their care through active listening and planning with their input, provide care coordination, practice cultural humility with each client, and utilize evidence-based practice as a foundation for our interventions.
The ideal candidate should have experience with home visits and passion for helping others while working independently in the field. You set your own schedule and are responsible for meeting your timelines.

Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Pflege, die Wirkung zeigt. Dort, wo Menschen am liebsten sind: zu Hause. Jeden Tag begleiten wir Menschen in ihrer vertrauten Umgebung.
Eine ältere Klientin, die trotz Krankheit in ihrem vertrauten Zuhause bleiben möchte. Ein jüngerer Klient, der nach dem Spitalaufenthalt Schritt für Schritt Sicherheit zurückgewinnt. Eine Familie, die in einer herausfordernden Situation kompetente Unterstützung erhält und wieder etwas durchatmen kann.

Bei Spitex Nidwalden sind rund 160 Fachkräfte für Gesundheit, Pflege und Hauswirtschaft täglich unterwegs. Gemeinsam ermöglichen wir Menschen ein selbstbestimmtes Leben in ihrer gewohnten Umgebung.

* Sie pflegen ganzheitlich: Sie stellen eine bedarfsgerechte Pflege sicher und unterstützen Menschen dabei, möglichst selbstbestimmt zu Hause zu leben.
* Sie beraten und begleiten: Sie sind für Klientinnen, Klienten und Angehörige eine verlässliche Ansprechperson und schaffen Sicherheit im Alltag.
* Sie übernehmen Verantwortung: Im Bezugspflegesystem können Sie zusätzlich die Fallverantwortung übernehmen und Ihre Fachkompetenz gezielt einsetzen.
* Sie koordinieren die Pflege: Als zentrale Ansprechperson stimmen Sie therapeutische Massnahmen mit dem Behandlungsteam ab.
* Sie arbeiten eigenständig: Ihre Einsätze finden direkt bei den Menschen zu Hause statt. Dadurch erleben Sie Pflege aus einer sehr persönlichen Perspektive.

* Ab 40 % Pensum möglich: Sie können bereits ab einem Teilzeitpensum einsteigen.
* Flexibler Stellenantritt: Sie starten per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung.

* Entwicklung: Sie erhalten Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen Weiterentwicklung und zum individuellen Ausbau Ihrer Kompetenzen.
## Worauf wir bei Ihnen zählen ##
* Ihre Erfahrung: Sie bringen Erfahrung in der ambulanten Pflege mit oder sind interessiert an einem Wechsel in die ambulante Pflege.
* Ihre Haltung: Sie arbeiten gerne mit Menschen und schätzen die Pflege im vertrauten zuhause. Sie sind eine verantwortungsbewusste und empathische Persönlichkeit.
* Ihre Persönlichkeit: Sie arbeiten selbstständig, flexibel und eigeninitiativ.
* Ihre Mobilität: Sie verfügen über einen gültigen Führerausweis und ein eigenes Auto.
